players.product: Tecochill hybrid-drive (natural-gas / electric) dual power source chillers (air-cooled, water-cooled and DTx) and InVerde power-generation modules for data-center cooling

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: one unnamed customer represented 15% of Tecogen's revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025; no customer represented more than 10% of revenue in 2024. One customer represented 11% of accounts receivable at December 31, 2025 (14% at December 31, 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: one unnamed customer 15% of FY2025 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: product revenues in 2025 were $9,133,450 versus $4,443,996 in 2024 (+105.5%), driven by increased unit volume - chiller sales $5,658,183 (+243.5% from $1,647,374), cogeneration $3,073,582 (+14.8%) and engineered accessories $401,685; total revenue was $27,073,710 (+19.7%). Product and installation backlog at December 31, 2025 was $2,522,231 versus $12,336,248 a year earlier (the 2024 backlog included an order for several chillers shipped in 2025 and cogeneration systems shipped in Q1 2025 to customers seeking Inflation Reduction Act tax credits); remaining performance obligations were approximately $4,796,863.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 chiller revenue $5,658,183 (+243.5%); product revenue $9,133,450 (+105.5%); backlog $2,522,231 at December 31, 2025 (December 31, 2024: $12,336,248)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K supplier disclosure: most components are fabricated from commonly available raw materials or are standard parts from multiple suppliers, and management believes adequate supplies exist for near-to-medium-term manufacturing needs; however, certain components of Tecogen's engine driven power inverter systems contain rare-earth minerals and are currently sole-sourced from a supplier in China (not named).

connects_to.relationship: Tecogen DTx chillers marketed and sold by Vertiv for data-center cooling (sales and marketing agreement)

contracts.signal: On February 28, 2025 Tecogen entered into a Sales and Marketing Agreement with Vertiv relating to sales of Tecogen DTx chillers for data center cooling applications. The agreement has a two-year term; Vertiv will establish a marketing budget and use commercially reasonable efforts to sell the DTx chillers, and the agreement provides the basis for negotiating a definitive supply agreement. Tecogen agreed to give Vertiv reasonable discounts for purchases of significant volumes of chillers, and Vertiv agreed to help Tecogen secure favorable terms for engineering components and supplies. Vertiv holds the exclusive right to market and sell DTx chillers for data center cooling outside the United States and a non-exclusive right within it, which becomes exclusive in the United States if Vertiv achieves and maintains agreed sales levels. Management believes that penetrating the data center market, including through the Vertiv partnership, may represent a significant revenue growth opportunity (no assurance given).
contracts.units: Tecogen DTx chillers for data-center cooling
